description: Take-home pay for an employee in Turkey from a gross yearly salary in TRY, with 2026 rules: every tax and contribution itemised with its local name, the effective and marginal rate, employer cost and the step-by-step workings. Covers: 2026 wage brackets applied month by month on cumulative income; Minimum-wage exemption from income and stamp tax; SGK and unemployment up to 9× the minimum wage; BES private pension, employer SGK with or without the incentive.

fx_per_eur.description: Exchange rate: 1 euro = this many TRY, for the euro amounts. Default 38 (indicative).

gross_annual.description: Gross yearly salary in TRY, without bonus

incentive.description: Employer SGK incentive: 2 = 2 points (most sectors, 2026); 5 = 5 points (manufacturing); 0 = None. Default 2.

tax_year.description: Tax year. Offered: 2026 (final), 2025 (final). Default 2026. A year that is not listed is not available for this country.
